headline: Tradr Launches Two Leveraged ETFs on SK hynix
summary: Tradr ETFs, a provider of ETFs designed for sophisticated investors and professional traders, today launched two single-stock leveraged ETFs with long and short exposure to SK hynix Inc.'s U.S-listed shares (Nasdaq: SKHY).  The funds, listed on Cboe, seek to deliver 200% and -200% of the daily performance of the South Korean semiconductor and memory chip maker.

headline: S&P Global (SPGI) Beats Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
